title: Adaptive Mixing of Policies from Searching and Policies from Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Distillation of training targets generated thru search/planning has proven useful in reinforcement learning, but search can take exceedingly long. Objectives: Rather than perform search to the same depth every time (typically at a fixed period of steps), reduce the search depth proportionally to the quality of the policy network priors. Methods: We describe Flexer, an architecture that, for each step, mixes the policy from a neural network and the policy from Monte Carlo tree search. The mixing factor favors the MCTS policy as the policy imitation error of the network and the environment models' variance increases. Results: Flexer outperforms a version of AlphaZero (and DQN and ADP) for some experiments on three toy symbolic problems.

translated_title: 搜索策略与学习策略的自适应混合
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15700v1 公告类型：新 摘要：背景：通过搜索/规划生成训练目标的蒸馏已在强化学习中被证明有效，但搜索可能耗时极长。目标：不是每次（通常在固定步数间隔）执行相同深度的搜索，而是根据策略网络先验的质量成比例地减少搜索深度。方法：我们描述了Flexer，一种架构，它在每一步混合来自神经网络的策略和来自蒙特卡洛树搜索的策略。混合因子在网络的策略模仿误差和环境模型的方差增加时偏向于MCTS策略。结果：在三个玩具符号问题的若干实验中，Flexer优于AlphaZero（以及DQN和ADP）的一个版本。
tldr: Flexer提出了一种自适应混合策略，根据策略网络质量和环境模型不确定性动态调整搜索深度与混合比例，从而在减少计算成本的同时提升性能。
en_tdlr: Flexer introduces an adaptive policy mixing approach that dynamically adjusts search depth and mixing ratio based on policy network quality and environmental model uncertainty, improving performance while reducing computational cost.
